summary.en-US: Observe content-free performance signals for oversized authenticated web applications.

version.approval_notes: Elatura is currently observe-only. Build instructions are in docs/amo-build-instructions.md. The submitted source archive contains the complete TypeScript source, frozen package-lock.json, build scripts, capability policy, tests, and documentation needed to reproduce and inspect the extension. No remote code, telemetry, native messaging, response transformation, or private-content cache is enabled.
